series.name: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)
series.notes: Huawei severity terms in this table are Major / Minor / Warning, which are NOT the same as the newer Major-alarm-shuts-down convention. Mapped here to stop_pro / check_restart / self_clear. Codes 2001-2072 and 61440 are read on the FusionSolar/SUN2000 app, SmartLogger or NMS - the inverter itself has no display. SEVERITY CONFLICTS with SERIES 3 (USL0): 2063 Overtemperature is Minor here but Major in USL0, and 2065 Upgrade Failed is Minor here but Major in USL0. Do not merge with SERIES 3.

title.ur: PV string input voltage bohat zyada

meaning.en: Too many PV modules are connected in series, so the string open-circuit voltage exceeds the inverter's maximum input voltage.
meaning.ur: PV string mein modules zyada series mein hain, is liye open-circuit voltage inverter ki maximum se zyada ho gaya.

causes.en: Too many modules wired in series in the PV array.
causes.ur: PV array mein series mein modules ki tadaad zyada hai.

causes.en: Series count differs per MPPT: Cause ID 1 = PV1 and PV2, Cause ID 2 = PV3 and PV4.
causes.ur: Har MPPT par series count alag hai: Cause ID 1 = PV1 aur PV2, Cause ID 2 = PV3 aur PV4.

solutions.en: With the DC switch OFF, measure the string Voc with a multimeter rated 1100 V DC or higher.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF kar ke, 1100 V DC ya us se upar wale multimeter se string ka Voc measure karein.

solutions.en: Recount the modules in series on the reported string and reconfigure so Voc stays under the inverter maximum.
solutions.ur: Mashoor string ke series modules dobara gin lein aur configuration aise karein ke Voc inverter ki maximum se kam rahe.

solutions.en: Confirm the alarm clears by itself once the array is correctly configured, then re-close the DC switch.
solutions.ur: Array sahi se configure hone ke baad alarm apne aap khatam hona chahiye, phir DC switch dobara band karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: DC arc fault (PV wiring mein charcha)

meaning.en: The PV string power cable is arcing or has a poor/loose connection. Fire risk - treat as urgent.
meaning.ur: PV string power cable mein arc ya loose connection hai. Aag ka khatra hai - foran dekh lein.

causes.en: PV string power cable arcs under load.
causes.ur: Load ke waqt PV string power cable mein arc ban raha hai.

causes.en: Loose or poorly crimped MC4 connector. Cause ID 1 = PV1/PV2, Cause ID 2 = PV3/PV4.
causes.ur: MC4 connector loose hai ya theek se crimp nahi hua. Cause ID 1 = PV1/PV2, Cause ID 2 = PV3/PV4.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then inspect every MC4 connector on the flagged string in daylight for scorch marks.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV disconnect kar ke, mashoor string ke har MC4 connector ko din mein dekh kar soor ke nishaan check karein.

solutions.en: Re-crimp or replace the affected connector with an approved type; never tape a hot connector.
solutions.ur: Affected connector ko dobara crimp karein ya approved type se badal dein; garam connector par tape mat lagayein.

solutions.en: After clearing, this alarm must be reset manually in the app, then restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Fault hatane ke baad yeh alarm app se manually reset karna hota hai, phir inverter restart karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: PV string ulti polarity se lagi hai

meaning.en: A PV string is wired into the inverter with polarity reversed.
meaning.ur: Koi PV string inverter mein ulti polarity se lagi hai.

causes.en: PV string connected to the wrong input / swapped polarity. Cause ID 1-4 map to PV1-PV4.
causes.ur: PV string galat input par lagi hai ya polarity swap ho gayi. Cause ID 1-4 PV1 se PV4 tak map hote hain.

causes.en: The string is landed on the wrong MPPT input, so it reads as reversed even when the module-to-string wiring itself is correct.
causes.ur: String galat MPPT input par lagi hai, is liye module se string ki wiring sahi hone par bhi yeh reversed nazar aati hai.

solutions.en: Wait for night or shading so string current drops below 0.5 A before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch karne se pehle raat ya shadow ka intezaar karein jab tak string current 0.5 A se neeche na gir jaye.

solutions.en: Set the DC SWITCH to OFF, then correct the string polarity at the input terminals.
solutions.ur: DC SWITCH ko OFF karein, phir input terminals par string ki polarity theek karein.

solutions.en: Re-measure polarity with a DC voltmeter (positive reading on the marked + input) before switching DC back on.
solutions.ur: DC wapas on karne se pehle DC voltmeter se polarity dobara check karein (marked + input par positive reading aaye).

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: String current backfeed (shorter string ka current)

meaning.en: Too few modules in series on one string, so its end voltage is lower than the parallel strings and current flows back into it.
meaning.ur: Ek string mein modules kam hain, is liye uska end voltage parallel strings se kam hai aur current wapas us mein ja raha hai.

causes.en: Fewer modules in series on this string than on the strings running parallel with it (Cause ID 1-4 = PV1-PV4).
causes.ur: Is string mein parallel wali doosri strings se modules kam hain (Cause ID 1-4 = PV1-PV4).

causes.en: Partial shading on this string only.
causes.ur: Sirf is string par partial shading hai.

solutions.en: Count series modules on the flagged string and compare with the parallel strings; equalise the counts.
solutions.ur: Mashoor string ke series modules gin kar parallel strings se compare karein; tadaad barabar karein.

solutions.en: Wait until string current falls below 0.5 A, set DC SWITCH to OFF, then adjust the module count.
solutions.ur: Jab tak string current 0.5 A se neeche na gir jaye, wait karein, DC SWITCH OFF karke module ki tadaad adjust karein.

solutions.en: Check for shading with an irradiance meter or by inspecting at different sun angles, then verify string Voc is normal.
solutions.ur: Shading check karne ke liye irradiance meter use karein ya alag alag dhoop ke angles par dekhein, phir string ka Voc normal check karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

aliases: Output phase wire short-circuited to PE

title.en: Output Phase Wire Short-Circuit to PE
title.ur: Output phase wire PE se short ho gaya

meaning.en: Impedance of an output phase wire to PE is low or short-circuited, so the inverter has earthed the AC output.
meaning.ur: Output phase wire ka PE se impedance kam hai ya short, is liye inverter ne AC output disconnect kar diya.

causes.en: Damaged AC cable insulation touching the PE conductor or enclosure metal.
causes.ur: AC cable ki insulation kharab hai aur woh PE conductor ya enclosure metal ko chhu rahi hai.

causes.en: Water or moisture tracking inside the AC output gland.
causes.ur: AC output gland ke andar paani ya nami leakage ho rahi hai.

solutions.en: Open AC switch first, lock it out, and tag it before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC switch kholein, lock out karein aur tag lagayein, phir koi bhi measurement karein.

solutions.en: Measure each phase conductor to PE with a megohmmeter and find the low-impedance leg.
solutions.ur: Har phase conductor ko PE ke against megohmmeter se measure karke kam impedance wali leg dhoondein.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged cable section or gland, then re-test before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Kharab cable section ya gland badal dein, phir dobara test karke hi energise karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Grid failure (AC ya grid ka nahi chalna)

meaning.en: The inverter has lost the grid or the AC supply. Usually clears automatically once the grid is back.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne grid ya AC supply khoya hai. Grid aane par khud ba khud theek ho jata hai.

causes.en: The power grid has an outage (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid mein outage hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: The AC circuit is disconnected or the AC switch is off.
causes.ur: AC circuit disconnect hai ya AC switch band hai.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage at the inverter terminals with a multimeter to confirm the grid is present.
solutions.ur: Confirm karne ke liye multimeter se inverter terminals par AC voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC switch and the AC cable terminations for a loose or open connection.
solutions.ur: AC switch aur AC cable ke terminations ko loose ya khuli connection ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Do not force a reset while the grid is absent; the inverter will retry on its own.
solutions.ur: Grid ki absence mein zor se reset na karein; inverter apne aap retry karega.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Grid undervoltage (voltage kam)

meaning.en: Grid voltage fell below the undervoltage threshold, or stayed low longer than the LVRT period.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage undervoltage threshold se neeche gir gaya, ya LVRT time se zyada der kam raha.

causes.en: Grid voltage below the lower threshold (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid voltage lower threshold se kam hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Undervoltage lasted longer than the configured LVRT value.
causes.ur: Undervoltage configured LVRT value se zyada der raha.

causes.en: Heavy load on a weak local distribution line, common on Pakistani feeder faults.
causes.ur: Kamzor local distribution line par heavy load — Pakistan mein feeder fault par aam baat hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the inverter AC terminals under load, not at an empty socket.
solutions.ur: Grid voltage inverter ke AC terminals par load ke saath measure karein, khali socket par nahi.

solutions.en: Check the AC switch and output power cable connection if the fault persists for a long time.
solutions.ur: Agar fault lambe arse tak rahe to AC switch aur output power cable ki connection check karein.

solutions.en: Only with the power operator's consent, adjust the undervoltage threshold via app, SmartLogger or NMS.
solutions.ur: Sirf power operator ki ijazat se app, SmartLogger ya NMS par undervoltage threshold change karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Grid overvoltage (voltage zyada)

meaning.en: Grid voltage rose above the upper threshold, or stayed high longer than the HVRT period.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage upper threshold se upar chala gaya, ya HVRT period se zyada der high raha.

causes.en: Grid voltage beyond the upper threshold (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid voltage upper threshold se upar hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: High voltage persisted longer than the configured HVRT value.
causes.ur: High voltage configured HVRT value se zyada der raha.

causes.en: Long cable run to the inverter raises the voltage seen at the AC terminals at peak generation.
causes.ur: Inverter tak lamba cable peak generation par AC terminals par voltage barha deta hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the inverter AC terminals and log the peak value over one clear day.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminals par grid voltage measure karein aur ek saaf din ka peak value note karein.

solutions.en: If voltage is genuinely above the utility limit, report it to the local power operator.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage waqai utility ki limit se upar hai to local power operator ko report karein.

solutions.en: Do not raise the threshold on your own; it needs the operator's written consent.
solutions.ur: Apne aap threshold barhana nahi hai; uske liye operator ki likhit ijazat chahiye.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Unbalanced grid voltage (phase voltage ka farq)

meaning.en: The difference between grid phase voltages exceeds the upper threshold.
meaning.ur: Grid phase voltages ka farq upper threshold se zyada hai.

causes.en: Phase-to-phase voltage difference above the upper limit (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Phase-to-phase voltage ka farq upper limit se upar hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Single-phase loads badly distributed across the three phases.
causes.ur: Teen phases par single-phase load khayal se baant na ho.

solutions.en: Measure all three phase-to-neutral voltages with a clamp meter or multimeter and record them.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter ya multimeter se teenon phase-to-neutral voltages measure kar record karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC output power cable terminations for a loose high-resistance connection on one phase.
solutions.ur: AC output power cable ke terminations check karein ke kisi ek phase par loose connection to nahi hai.

solutions.en: If cabling is sound, report the persistent imbalance to the local power operator.
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek hai to lambe arse ki imbalance local power operator ko report karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Grid overfrequency

meaning.en: Actual grid frequency is higher than the standard required for the local grid.
meaning.ur: Actual grid frequency local grid ke standard se zyada hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency above the local standard limit (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid frequency local standard limit se upar hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Generator-backed supply or a lightly loaded feeder running at over-frequency.
causes.ur: Generator se chalti supply ya halki load par chal raha feeder over-frequency par.

solutions.en: Read the live frequency from the inverter display/app, not from a cheap clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Live frequency inverter ki app ya display se dekhein, sasti clamp meter se nahi.

solutions.en: If it is occasional, wait for the grid to normalise; the inverter auto-recovers.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar nahi hai to grid normal hone ka intezaar karein; inverter khud recover ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If frequent, log the frequency and report to the power operator; adjust threshold only with their consent.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to frequency note karke power operator ko batayein; threshold sirf unhi ki ijazat se badlein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Grid underfrequency

meaning.en: Actual grid frequency is lower than the standard required for the local grid.
meaning.ur: Actual grid frequency local grid ke standard se kam hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency below the local standard limit (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid frequency local standard limit se kam hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Heavy generator loading on a weak local grid pulling frequency down.
causes.ur: Kamzor local grid par generator ka heavy load frequency gir raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the live frequency on the inverter app while recording whether load shedding is happening upstream.
solutions.ur: Inverter app par live frequency dekhein aur note karein ke upstream par load shedding ho rahi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If occasional, let the inverter auto-recover once frequency returns inside the window.
solutions.ur: Agar occasional hai to frequency window mein wapas aane par inverter ko khud recover hone dein.

solutions.en: If frequent, report to the power operator before touching the underfrequency threshold.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to underfrequency threshold chhune se pehle power operator ko batayein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Grid frequency unstable hai

meaning.en: The rate of change of grid frequency does not comply with the local grid standard.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency ka badalne ki rate local grid standard ke mutabiq nahi hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency change rate violates the local grid code (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid frequency change rate local grid code ka khilaf hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Large motor or generator starting/stopping on the same feeder.
causes.ur: Usi feeder par koi bada motor ya generator start/stop ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Log frequency over time in the app or NMS and note the timestamps of large loads switching.
solutions.ur: App ya NMS par time ke saath frequency log karein aur bade loads switch hone ke time note karein.

solutions.en: Check whether a neighbour generator or large motor starts exactly when the alarm appears.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke alarm kaane waqt hi koi padosi ka generator ya bada motor start hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If cabling and load are fine, report the unstable frequency to the power operator.
solutions.ur: Agar wiring aur load theek hain to power operator ko unstable frequency report karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Output overcurrent (AC current zyada)

meaning.en: A sudden grid voltage drop or a short circuit pushed the inverter's transient output current above the protection threshold.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage ka sudden girna ya short circuit ne inverter ke transient output current ko protection threshold se upar le jaaya.

causes.en: Grid voltage drops dramatically or the grid is short-circuited (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid voltage achanak gir gaya ya grid short ho gaya (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Inverter transient output current exceeded the upper threshold, tripping protection.
causes.ur: Inverter ka transient output current upper threshold se upar gaya aur protection chali.

solutions.en: First let the inverter auto-recover; it monitors external conditions in real time.
solutions.ur: Pehle inverter ko khud recover hone dein; yeh real time par external conditions monitor karta hai.

solutions.en: If the alarm repeats and cuts production, isolate AC and check the output circuit for a short with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm dohray aur production roke to AC isolate kar ke multimeter se output circuit mein short check karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC cable terminations and the AC switch for a hot or loose joint.
solutions.ur: AC cable terminations aur AC switch ko garam ya loose joint ke liye check karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Output ka DC component zyada hai

meaning.en: The DC component of the inverter's output current exceeded the specified upper threshold.
meaning.ur: Inverter output current ka DC component specified upper threshold se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: DC component of the SUN2000 output current exceeded the upper limit (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: SUN2000 output current ka DC component upper limit se upar gaya (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Distorted or unstable grid waveform from a weak or overloaded feeder.
causes.ur: Kamzor ya overloaded feeder se grid waveform bigda hua ya unstable hai.

solutions.en: Record the live waveform and frequency on the inverter app before any hardware work.
solutions.ur: Koi hardware kaam karne se pehle inverter app par live waveform aur frequency record karein.

solutions.en: If it repeats, isolate AC and verify the PE and N connections are correct and tight.
solutions.ur: Agar dohraye to AC isolate karke PE aur N connections sahi aur mazboot hain check karein.

solutions.en: If the grid waveform is the cause, report the distortion to the power operator rather than changing the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar wajah grid waveform hai to inverter badalne ke bajaye power operator ko distortion batayein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Abnormal residual current (leakage current zyada)

meaning.en: Insulation impedance from the input side to PE fell while the inverter was running, so the RCD/residual-current protection acted.
meaning.ur: Inverter chalte waqt input side se PE ki insulation impedance gir gayi, is liye RCD ne kaam kiya.

causes.en: Insulation impedance of the input side to PE decreased during operation (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Chalne ke dauran input side se PE ki insulation impedance kam ho gayi (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Wet, dusty or rodent-damaged PV string insulation after monsoon humidity.
causes.ur: Monsoon humidity ke baad geeli, dhool bhari ya chuhe se kharab PV string insulation.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure each string's resistance to PE with a megohmmeter at 500 V or 1000 V test voltage.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV disconnect kar ke, har string ka PE ke against resistance 500 V ya 1000 V test voltage par megohmmeter se measure karein.

solutions.en: Split the array string by string to find the wet or damaged section; look for cracked backsheets and chewed cables.
solutions.ur: Har string ko alag alag karke geela ya kharab hissa dhoondein; cracked backsheet aur chuhiye se kaata cable dekhein.

solutions.en: Dry the affected connectors, replace damaged insulation, and only then reset the protection threshold.
solutions.ur: Affected connectors ko sukha dein, kharab insulation badal dein, phir hi protection threshold reset karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Abnormal grounding (earth connection kharab)

meaning.en: The PE cable or neutral-earth arrangement is wrong, so the inverter's residual voltage check tripped.
meaning.ur: PE cable ya neutral-earth ka connection ghalat hai, is liye inverter ka residual voltage check chala.

causes.en: The N cable or ground cable is not connected (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: N cable ya ground cable connected nahi hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: When the PV array is earthed, the inverter output is not connected to an isolation transformer.
causes.ur: PV array grounded hone par inverter output isolation transformer se connected nahi hai.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter and verify the PE cable is bonded to the enclosure earth stud with a low-resistance joint.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein aur check karein ke PE cable enclosure earth stud se kam resistance ke joint se lagi hai.

solutions.en: On a TN grid, measure the neutral-to-earth voltage; it should be near zero.
solutions.ur: TN grid par neutral-to-earth voltage measure karein; yeh lagbhag zero hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If an isolation transformer is fitted, set Grounding inspection to Disable via app, SmartLogger or NMS.
solutions.ur: Agar isolation transformer laga hai to app, SmartLogger ya NMS par Grounding inspection ko Disable karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Low insulation resistance (PV insulation kam)

meaning.en: The PV array's resistance to ground is too low: either a short to PE, or damp air has degraded the insulation between modules and ground.
meaning.ur: PV array ka ground ke against resistance kam hai: ya to PE se short hai, ya damp weather mein module aur ground ke darmiyan insulation kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: PV array is short-circuited with PE (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: PV array PE se short ho gaya hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Ambient air around the PV array is damp, so insulation between array and ground is poor.
causes.ur: PV array ke aas paas ka hawa damp hai, is liye array aur ground ke darmiyan insulation kamzor hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV first; then measure the array-to-ground output resistance with a megohmmeter.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC aur PV disconnect karein; phir megohmmeter se array-to-ground output resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the inverter PE cable is correctly connected before hunting array faults.
solutions.ur: Array fault dhoondne se pehle confirm karein ke inverter ka PE cable theek se connected hai.

solutions.en: Clean and dry connectors, replace cracked MC4 parts, and re-measure before resetting the threshold.
solutions.ur: Connectors saaf aur sukha karein, cracked MC4 parts badal dein, aur threshold reset karne se pehle dobara measure karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Overtemperature (inverter garm ho gaya)

meaning.en: The inverter's internal temperature is high - poor ventilation, high ambient, or a unit fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka andar ka temperature zyada hai - ventilation kam, ambient zyada, ya unit mein kharabi.

causes.en: SUN2000 installed where ventilation is poor (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: SUN2000 aise jagah lagai hai jahan ventilation kam hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Ambient temperature exceeds the upper threshold.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature upper threshold se zyada hai.

causes.en: The SUN2000 is not working properly (internal or fan fault).
causes.ur: SUN2000 theek nahi chal raha (internal ya fan fault).

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the installation point with an IR or contact thermometer.
solutions.ur: Installation point par IR ya contact thermometer se ambient temperature measure karein.

solutions.en: Check for blocked air paths, a hot wall behind the unit, or stacked equipment above it; clear at least the documented clearance.
solutions.ur: Blocked air paths, unit ke peechhe garm deewar ya upar rakhte samay equipment check karein; kam az kam documented clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: Confirm the internal fan runs (M0 is fanless - an audible fan means a different model); on fan models clean the fan and filter.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke internal fan chal raha hai (M0 fanless hai - sunai de raha fan matlab model hi different hai); fan wale models par fan aur filter saaf karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Device fault (inverter ki andar ki kharabi)

meaning.en: An unrecoverable fault occurred on a circuit inside the inverter. Cause IDs 1-12 identify which internal circuit.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar kisi circuit par unrecoverable fault aaya hai. Cause ID 1-12 batata hai ke kaun sa circuit.

causes.en: Unrecoverable fault on an internal circuit, Cause ID 1-12.
causes.ur: Internal circuit par unrecoverable fault, Cause ID 1-12.

causes.en: The fault is current-dependent: the manual's note that Cause ID 1 must be handled only below 1 A PV string current shows this circuit trips on load, not at rest.
causes.ur: Fault current par depend karta hai: manual ka note ke Cause ID 1 ko sirf 1 A PV string current se neeche handle karna hai, is liye yeh circuit load par trip karta hai, khud to nahi.

solutions.en: Turn off the AC output switch, then the DC input switch, and wait 5 minutes before doing anything.
solutions.ur: AC output switch band karein, phir DC input switch band karein, aur kuch karne se pehle 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Turn them back on in the reverse order and watch the app for the same Cause ID.
solutions.ur: Ulta order mein on karein aur app par wahi Cause ID dobara aata hai ya nahi dekhein.

solutions.en: If Cause ID is 1, do this step only while PV string current is below 1 A, then note the Cause ID for Huawei support.
solutions.ur: Agar Cause ID 1 hai to yeh kaam sirf PV string current 1 A se kam hone par karein, phir Huawei support ke liye Cause ID note karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

aliases: Upgrade Failed or Software Version Unmatch

title.ur: Upgrade fail ya software version mismatch

meaning.en: A firmware upgrade did not complete normally. Cause IDs 1, 2 and 4 are listed in this manual.
meaning.ur: Firmware upgrade normally complete nahi hua. Is manual mein Cause ID 1, 2 aur 4 listed hain.

causes.en: The upgrade process did not end normally (Cause ID 1, 2, 4).
causes.ur: Upgrade process normally end nahi hua (Cause ID 1, 2, 4).

causes.en: Inverter stuck in initialisation state with PV inputs disconnected, then reconnected.
causes.ur: Inverter initialisation state mein atak gaya, PV inputs disconnect karke dobara connect kiye gaye.

solutions.en: Run the upgrade again using a SanDisk, Netac or Kingston USB flash drive with the script at the root.
solutions.ur: SanDisk, Netac ya Kingston USB flash drive se upgrade dobara chalayein, script root mein rakhein.

solutions.en: Leave PV disconnected during the retry so the unit reaches the upgrade state, then reconnect PV only after the restart.
solutions.ur: Retry ke dauran PV disconnect chhodein taake unit upgrade state tak pahunche, restart ke baad hi PV dobara connect karein.

solutions.en: If it fails several times, record the Cause ID and escalate to Huawei support instead of repeating blindly.
solutions.ur: Agar kai baar fail ho to Cause ID note karke Huawei support ko batayein, baar baar anjaan retry na karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: License expire ho gaya (privilege certificate)

meaning.en: The privilege certificate has entered its grace period, or the privilege feature will soon become invalid.
meaning.ur: Privilege certificate grace period mein aa gaya hai, ya privilege feature jald invalid ho jayega.

causes.en: The privilege certificate has entered the grace period (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Privilege certificate grace period mein aa gaya hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: The privilege feature will become invalid soon.
causes.ur: Privilege feature jald invalid ho jayega.

solutions.en: Apply for a new certificate for the exact serial number of the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit ke exact serial number ke liye naya certificate apply karein.

solutions.en: Load the new certificate via the app, SmartLogger or NMS and confirm the grace-period alarm clears.
solutions.ur: Naya certificate app, SmartLogger ya NMS se load karein aur confirm karein ke grace-period alarm khatam ho gaya.

solutions.en: Check the inverter's date and time are correct first; a wrong clock can make a valid certificate look expired.
solutions.ur: Pehle inverter ki date aur time sahi hain ya nahi check karein; galat clock valid certificate ko expired dikha deta hai.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Faulty power collector (power meter ki comms)

meaning.en: Communication between the inverter and the power meter (collector) has been interrupted.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur power meter (collector) ke darmiyan communication toot gaya hai.

causes.en: The power meter communication is interrupted (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Power meter ki communication interrupt ho gayi (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: RS485 wiring polarity swapped or screen at both ends.
causes.ur: RS485 wiring ki polarity uli hui hai ya dono taraf se shield nahi hua.

solutions.en: Confirm the power meter model setting in the inverter matches the physical meter model.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke inverter mein power meter ka model setting physical meter ke model se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Check the RS485 communication parameters on both the meter and the SUN2000 are identical.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke RS485 communication parameters meter aur SUN2000 dono par identical hain.

solutions.en: Verify the meter is powered and the RS485 cable A/B conductors are correctly terminated.
solutions.ur: Verify karein ke meter powered hai aur RS485 cable ke A/B conductors sahi terminate hain.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Transient AC overvoltage (momentary voltage spike)

meaning.en: The inverter measured an AC phase voltage above its transient overvoltage protection threshold.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne AC phase voltage ko transient overvoltage protection threshold se upar detect kiya.

causes.en: Inverter detected a phase voltage above the transient AC overvoltage threshold (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Inverter ne transient AC overvoltage threshold se upar phase voltage detect kiya (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Switch-on surge from the grid, e.g. when a large capacitor bank or transformer is energised.
causes.ur: Grid se switch-on surge, jaise bada capacitor bank ya transformer on hone par.

solutions.en: Log the AC peak voltage in the app during the event to see how far above the threshold it went.
solutions.ur: Event ke dauran app par AC peak voltage log karein dekhne ke liye ke threshold se kitna upar gaya.

solutions.en: If grid connection voltage exceeds the upper limit, report it to the local power operator.
solutions.ur: Agar grid connection voltage upper limit se upar hai to local power operator ko report karein.

solutions.en: Only with operator consent, raise the transient overvoltage threshold via app, SmartLogger or NMS.
solutions.ur: Sirf operator ki ijazat se app, SmartLogger ya NMS par transient overvoltage threshold barhayein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

title.ur: Monitoring unit faulty (flash memory ki kharabi)

meaning.en: The monitoring unit's flash memory is insufficient or has bad sectors, so logging and monitoring fail.
meaning.ur: Monitoring unit ki flash memory kam hai ya us mein bad sectors hain, is liye logging aur monitoring fail ho gayi.

causes.en: The flash memory is insufficient (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Flash memory insufficient hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: The flash memory has bad sectors.
causes.ur: Flash memory mein bad sectors hain.

solutions.en: Turn off the AC output switch, then the DC input switch, and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: AC output switch band karein, phir DC input switch band karein, aur 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Turn the AC switch on first, then the DC switch, and confirm the alarm clears in the app.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC switch on karein, phir DC switch, aur app par alarm khatam hone ki tasdeeq karein.

solutions.en: If the flash keeps failing, note the serial number and log export and raise a warranty case for the board.
solutions.ur: Agar flash baar baar fail ho to serial number aur log export note karke board ke liye warranty case raise karein.
